# arin_ticket_message (Resource)

Append one message to an existing ARIN ticket and retain its receipt. Changing content or replacing this resource sends another message. Refresh never resubmits, including after expiry. Destroy only forgets the receipt; ARIN exposes no message update or delete operation. Uncertain submissions block refresh and destroy until manually reconciled and imported. Message content and attachments are stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This sends correspondence to an existing ARIN ticket.
# Changing the content submits a new message; destroy only forgets the receipt.
resource "arin_ticket_message" "example" {
  ticket_number = "20260923-X1"
  subject       = "Requested information"
  text          = ["Additional information for this request."]
  category      = "JUSTIFICATION"
  attachments = {
    "evidence.txt" = base64encode("Supporting evidence")
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ticket_number` (String) Existing non-closed ticket receiving the message.

### Optional

- `attachments` (Map of String, Sensitive) Filename to base64 content. Changes send a new message. The encoded request and each downloaded attachment are limited to 4 MiB.
- `category` (String) NONE or JUSTIFICATION. Changes send a new message.
- `subject` (String, Sensitive) Message subject. Changes send a new message.
- `text` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered text lines. Changes send a new message.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) Server message creation date.
- `id` (String) TICKET/MESSAGE, or a temporary recovery identity.
- `message_available` (Boolean) False after a previously confirmed message returns 404. The receipt remains and is not resubmitted.
- `message_id` (String) Generated message ID within the ticket.
- `pending_submission` (Boolean) An uncertain POST requires reconciliation and import before retries.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_ticket_message.example '20260923-X1/1'
```
